content.title: Barrick exits Canadian gold mining with over $1 billion Hemlo sale
content.summary: Barrick Mining said on Wednesday it will sell its last producing Canadian gold mine, Hemlo, to Carcetti Capital for up to $1.09 billion.  Hemlo has produced more than 21 million ounces of gold and was once one of Canada's most important mining camps.  Its sale ends Barrick's long history of gold production in Canada, though the company said it will continue to pursue early-stage projects and exploration targets in the country.
